# fjordrun_service_access (Data Source)

Login and connection details of a service created from a template, filled in from its variables: for example a database's connection URL. Empty for other services. Needs the member role: for a viewer's token it is an error.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "service_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "environment_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_service_access" "postgres" {
  service_id     = var.service_id
  environment_id = var.environment_id
}

output "connection_url" {
  value     = data.fjordrun_service_access.postgres.values["Connection URL"]
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String) Service ID.

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID. Defaults to the project's default environment.

### Read-Only

- `fields` (Attributes List, Sensitive) The login and connection values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fields))
- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.
- `notes` (String) Notes on how to connect.
- `public_url` (String, Sensitive) The connection URL through public TCP, when that is on.
- `values` (Map of String, Sensitive) The same values by label.

<a id="nestedatt--fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `fields`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) What it is.
- `secret` (Boolean) Whether the dashboard hides it.
- `value` (String) The value.
